headline: For every unit bank vector a, the exact-spectrum family diag(1,aa^T,-aa^T) with identical centered-unit-cube banks and an arbitrary cap-one singleton heavy law has global density norm at most K_*=(pi/2)(sqrt(2)+2^(1/4))<3sqrt(2); this closes the equal-bank finite-m gap for every m and allows arbitrary bank leverage profiles.
mathematical_premises: Centered interval linear combinations have even nonincreasing densities; iid difference-square kernels are even nonincreasing in absolute value.

The predecessor exact bathtub argument extends from equal bank weights to any identical weighted centered-cube banks, so the arbitrary heavy cap-one law and output are optimized by the centered unit interval at output zero.
Ball/Rogozin one-dimensional cube-projection cap: a unit-norm projection of the centered unit cube has density at most sqrt(2).
Applying the same projection cap to (S_a-S_a')/sqrt(2) gives ||h||_2^2<=1.
Polar enlargement of the cone-tip strip and a split L-infinity/L2 estimate yield C(a)<=(pi/2)(sqrt(2)+2^(1/4)).

required_source_applied.application: The Ball/Rogozin cube-projection input used in the source's Lp lemma is applied twice to the actual bank, proving ||h||infinity<=sqrt(2) and ||h||2^2<=1. The source's Theorem C is also applied as an auxiliary p(s)<=pi sqrt(2) one-sheet comparison; the new cone estimate sharpens the present family globally below 3sqrt(2).

partner_applied.result: The canonical dense Householder cube A=I-2ee^T, e=(1,1,1)/sqrt(3), has exact global peak 2.5343552034...; combining with the new all-bank bound gives the union of these complementary finite exact-spectrum stress classes below 3sqrt(2).

correction_compatibility: No consumed correction invalidates the proof: it remains in original physical product coordinates, uses no general-joint coarea, no conditional-density moment, no post-rotation independence, no pointwise stationary phase, no fixed fragment-count reduction, and no rowwise near-null split.
unresolved_implication: The theorem requires identical centered-cube rank-one banks. Unequal opposite banks, multiple non-collinear/shared-coordinate intermediate-leverage heavy rows, additional active spectrum, and genuinely coupled multiscale fragmented marginals remain outside the class.
next_step: Attack an unequal-bank or shared-coordinate intermediate-leverage exact-spectrum witness; preserve the distinction that a peak above 3sqrt(2) refutes only the proposed sharp constant unless it can be made unbounded.
